questions.question: In ∆ABC, if the ratio of angles is in the proportion 3 : 5 : 4, then the difference between the biggest and the smallest angles (in degrees) is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

Sum of all three angles of a triangle = 180

Ratio of all three angles of a triangle = 3 : 5 : 4

3 + 5 + 4 = 12 unit

According to question, 12 unit = 180

⇒ 1 unit = 180/12 = 15

Hence, required difference = 5 – 3 = 2 unit

∴ 2 unit = 15 × 2 = 30

questions.question: A shopkeeper fixes the price of an article in such a way that after allowing 32% discount, he wants a gain of 14%. If the marked price is Rs. 342, then the cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
MP of the article = 342

SP of the article = 342 × (68/100)

∴ CP of the article = 342 × (68/100) × (100/114) = Rs. 204

questions.question: 25 litres of a mixture contains 30% of spirit and the rest is water. If 5 litres of water is mixed in it, the percentage of spirit in the new mixture is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total quantity of mixture = 25 

Percentage of spirit = 30%

**Calculations:**

Quantity of sprit in 25 liters mixture = 25 × 30/100 = 7.5

New quantity of mixture if 5 liters water add = 25 + 5 = 30

New percentage of spirit in new mixture = (7.5/30) × 100 = 25%

**∴ New percentage of spirit in new mixture is 25% **

questions.question: The sum of the squares of 3 natural numbers is 1029, and they are in the proportion 1 : 2 : 4, The difference between the greatest number and the smallest number is:
questions.solution:
The ratio of three natural numbers = x : 2x : 4x

According to the question

x² + (2x)² + (4x)² = 1029

⇒ x² + 4x² + 16x² = 1029

⇒ 21x² = 1029

⇒ x² = 1029/21

⇒ x² = 49

⇒ x = √49 = 7

∴ Difference between greatest number and smallest numbers = 4x – x = 3x = 3 × 7 = 21

questions.question: A, B and C can individually complete a task in 20 days, 16 days, and 30 days, respectively. If A and B started working on the task, and they worked for 4 days and left, then the number of days required by C to finish the remaining task is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f738719159822ebb059181dcaf54facfa13f3536c9fc589324eaf136458f587b.png] 

Total work = 240

Work done by A and B in 4 days = (12 + 15) × 4 = 108

Remaining work = 240 – 108 = 132

∴ Remaining work, C complete in = 132/8 = 16(1)/(2) days

questions.question: The percentage of increase (per kg) in the rate of commodity D from 2016 to 2019 is:
questions.solution:

Price increased by = 85 = 75 = 10

questions.question: The rate of simple interest on a sum of money is 5% p.a. for the first 4 years, 8% p.a. for the next 3 years and 10% p.a. for the period beyond 7 years. If the simple interest accumulated by the sum over a period of 10 years is Rs. 1,850, then the sum is:
questions.solution:
Interest rate for first 4 years = 5%

Interest rate for next 3 years = 8%

Interest rate for next 3 years = 10%

Total simple interest for 10 years = Rs. 1850

As we know, SI = Prt/100

According to the question

(P × 5 × 4)/100 + (P × 8 × 3)/100 + (P × 10 × 3)/100 = 1850

⇒ 20P/100 + 24P/100 + 30P/100 = 1850

⇒ 74P = 185000

⇒ P = 185000/74

∴ P = Rs. 2500

**Short Trick: **

Let Principal be 100% and SI for 10 years = 1850

Total percentage of interest for 10 years = 4 × 5 + 3 × 8 + 3 × 10 = 74%

74% = 1850

⇒ 1% = 25

⇒ 100% = 2500

questions.question: The average of 60 student’s results is 38. If the average of the first 22 students is 36, and that of the last 32 students is 32, then the average result of the remaining students is:
questions.solution:
Average of 60 students’ results = 38

Sum of 60 students’ results = 38 × 60 = 2280

Average of first 22 students’ results = 36

Sum of first 22 students’ results = 36 × 22 = 792

Average of last 32 students’ results = 32

Sum of last 32 students’ results = 32 × 32 = 1024

Sum of remaining 6 student’s results = 2280 – 792 – 1024 = 464

∴ Average of remaining 6 students’ results = 464/6 = 77.33

questions.question: The extra amount spent on commodities B and C in the year 2019 as compared to that in the year 2016, is:

Extra amount spent on commodity C in 2019 as compared to 2016 = 12 × (40 – 35) = 60

∴ Total extra amount = 200 + 60 = 260

questions.question: If a³ + 1/a³ = 52, then the value of 2 (a + 1/a) is:
questions.solution:
a³ + 1/a³ = 52

As we know,

(a + 1/a)³ = a³ + 1/a³ + 3 (a + 1/a) ---(1)

From the option

2 (a + 1/a) = 8

(a + 1/a) = 4

From equation (1)

4³ = a³ + 1/a³ + 3 × 4

⇒ a³ + 1/a³ = 64 – 12 = 52 (satisfied)

questions.question: A train crosses a platform 180 m long in 60 sec at a speed of 72 km/h. the time taken by the train to cross an electric pole is:
questions.solution:
Let the length of the train be x meter. And length of the platform is 180.

Speed of train = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/sec

As we know,

Speed = Distance/Time

20 = (180 + x)/60

⇒ 1200 = 180 + x

⇒ x = 1200 – 180 = 1020

∴ Required time to cross poll by train = 1020/20 = 51 sec

questions.question: The inner and outer radius of a circular track are, respectively, 23 m and 29 m. The cost of levelling the track at Rs. 7/m² is:
questions.solution:
Inner radius of circular track r = 23 m and Outer radius of circular track R = 29 m

As we know,

Area of circular track = π (R² – r²) = 22/7 (29² – 23²) = 22/7 × 6 × 52 m²

Cost of leveling 1 m² the track = Rs. 7

∴ Cost of leveling 22/7 × 6 × 52 m² = 22/7 × 6 × 52 × 7 = 6864

**Short Trick : **

Answer divisible by 11 only, one option 6864 divisible by 11.
